Name: Eregion Glorfindel Restore
Description: V-17 (SEC7): what a restore from Azure Backup that a human approved needs (the console, the bot) - the Run Command neutralised, the VM deallocated, its disks restored in place from the vault through the staging storage account, then started. Never given to the watch: Glorfindel never restores on its own. Assigned on the VM's resource group, the vault's and the staging account's. Reads come from Reader.
